# Casdoor

> Casdoor is an open-source, UI-first Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Single Sign-On (SSO) platform written in Go. It supports OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, CAS, LDAP, SCIM, WebAuthn, TOTP, MFA, RADIUS and Kerberos, includes an MCP server, and acts as an OAuth 2.1 authorization server for MCP servers and AI agents.

## 基础

- [What is Casdoor](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/overview/): Casdoor 是一个用 Go 编写、以界面配置为主的开源 IAM 和 SSO 平台，支持 OAuth 2.0、OIDC、SAML、CAS、LDAP、SCIM、WebAuthn、MFA 和 RADIUS。看看它是如何工作的。
- [核心概念](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/basic/core-concepts/): Organizations, users, applications, and providers are the four objects that every Casdoor setup is built from.
- [Install the Casdoor server](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/basic/server-installation/): Install Casdoor from a pre-built binary or from source, connect it to a database, and sign in to the admin console.
- [Configuration reference](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/basic/configuration/): Every option in the Casdoor configuration file app.conf, and how to override options with environment variables.
- [Run Casdoor with Docker](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/basic/try-with-docker/): Run Casdoor in a Docker container, either with the all-in-one image for a quick trial or with the standard image and your own database.
- [Run Casdoor on Kubernetes with Helm](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/basic/try-with-helm/): Install the Casdoor Helm chart on a Kubernetes cluster, expose it with Ingress or the Gateway API, and manage the release.
- [Call the Casdoor API](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/basic/public-api/): Authenticate to the Casdoor REST API with an access token, client credentials, an access key, or a username and password, and call it from your applications and scripts.
- [Tutorials from the community](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/basic/tutorials/): Documentation of other products and articles by the community that show how to use Casdoor for single sign-on.

## 对比

- [Casdoor 与其他方案对比](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/comparison/overview/): Casdoor 与 Keycloak、Authentik、Auth0、Logto 在开发语言、许可证、协议、AI 智能体与 MCP 支持以及运维方面的对比。
- [Feature comparison](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/comparison/feature-comparison/): Casdoor, Keycloak, ZITADEL, and authentik compared feature by feature - SAML IdP, LDAP server, multi-tenancy, SCIM, forward auth, RADIUS, CAS, Kubernetes, and scaling.
- [Casdoor 与 Keycloak 对比](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-keycloak/): Casdoor 与 Keycloak 的实用对比：架构、协议、定制、AI 智能体和 MCP 支持、运维，以及如何从 Keycloak 迁移用户。
- [Casdoor 与 Authentik 对比](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-authentik/): 从自托管 SSO 的角度对比 Casdoor 和 Authentik：架构、流程与界面定制、协议、反向代理认证、许可证，以及对 AI 智能体的支持。
- [Casdoor 与 Auth0 对比](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-auth0/): Casdoor 与 Auth0 对比：开源自托管与托管服务、定价方式、数据存放位置、可定制性，以及对 AI 智能体和 MCP 的支持。
- [Casdoor 与 Logto 对比](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-logto/): 对比 Casdoor 和 Logto：开发语言和许可证、数据库、协议、多租户、企业目录功能，以及 AI 智能体和 MCP 服务器的认证。

## LLM

- [OpenClaw](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/llm/openclaw/): 用 OpenClaw 可观测性代理在 Casdoor 中收集 LLM 智能体的追踪、指标和日志。
- [MCP 安全](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/llm/mcp-security/): Casdoor 如何保护 MCP 部署：用 OAuth 2.1 做访问控制，用 OpenTelemetry 做审计和可观测性。

## Deployment

- [Deploy Casdoor with Docker](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/docker/): Run Casdoor in production with Docker or Docker Compose, behind Traefik, Nginx, or Caddy with HTTPS.
- [Deploy Casdoor behind Nginx](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/nginx/): Put Nginx in front of the Casdoor backend as a reverse proxy for your domain.
- [在 Kubernetes 上部署 Casdoor](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/k8s/): Deploy Casdoor on a Kubernetes cluster with the example manifest, expose it with Ingress, and protect other applications with oauth2-proxy.
- [Initialize and manage data with a file](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/data-initialization/): Load organizations, applications, users, and other objects into Casdoor from a JSON or YAML file, keep them in sync with the file, and export them.
- [Manage Casdoor with Terraform](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/terraform/): Manage Casdoor organizations, applications, users, providers, certs, roles, permissions, and groups as code with the official Terraform provider.
- [Host the frontend files on a CDN](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/deploy-cdn/): Upload the built Casdoor frontend to a CDN through a storage provider, so that browsers load JavaScript and CSS from the CDN.
- [Host static files on an intranet](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/deploy-intranet/): Serve the images and logos that Casdoor loads from a public CDN from a server inside your own network.
- [数据库迁移](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/db-migration/): How Casdoor changes its database schema between versions, and when a manual migration is needed.
- [Upgrade from v3 to v4](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/upgrade-v3-to-v4/): What changed between Casdoor v3 and v4, which v4 release to use, how to upgrade, and what to check afterward.
- [版本信息](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/version-info/): How Casdoor determines its version in source builds, release binaries, and Docker images, and how to read it.

## 接入 Casdoor

- [Connect an application to Casdoor](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/overview/): Choose how your application signs users in with Casdoor - OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, SAML, or CAS - and whether to use an OIDC library, a Casdoor SDK, or a plugin.
- [Connect a standard OIDC client](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/oidc-client/): Point any OpenID Connect client library at the Casdoor discovery endpoint, and learn what the discovery document and the UserInfo endpoint return.
- [Sign users in with a Casdoor SDK](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/sdk/): Find the Casdoor SDK for your platform, and use a frontend SDK and a backend SDK together to sign users in, verify the access token, and call the Casdoor API.
- [Set up single sign-on](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/session/single-sign-on/): Let users sign in once and open every application of their organization without signing in again.
- [Sign users out of all applications](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/session/single-sign-out/): Sign a user out of every application of the organization at once with the SSO logout endpoint, and notify your applications so that they end their own sessions.
- [RP 发起的登出](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/session/rp-initiated-logout/): Reference for the OpenID Connect end-session endpoint of Casdoor, which a client application calls to sign the user out of Casdoor.
- [Sign users in to a Vue application](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/vue-sdk/): Add Casdoor sign-in to a Vue 2 or Vue 3 application with casdoor-vue-sdk.
- [Sign users in to an Electron app](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/electron-app/): Run the Casdoor Electron example, which signs users in through the system browser and a custom protocol, and add the same flow to your own app.
- [Sign users in to a .NET desktop app](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/dotnet-app/): Run the Casdoor .NET desktop example, which signs users in through WebView2, and add the same flow to your own app.
- [Sign users in to a .NET MAUI app](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/maui-app/): Add Casdoor sign-in to a .NET MAUI app on Android and Windows with the Casdoor.MauiOidcClient library.
- [Sign users in to a Qt desktop app](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/qt-app/): Run the Casdoor Qt example, which signs users in through Qt WebEngine and casdoor-cpp-sdk, and add the same flow to your own C++ app.
- [Sign users in to a React Native app](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mobile-sdks/react-native-app/): Run the Casdoor React Native example on iOS and Android, and add Casdoor sign-in to your own app with casdoor-react-native-sdk.
- [Manage Casdoor from the command line](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/cli/): Install the Casdoor CLI, connect it to your Casdoor instance, and manage users and groups from the terminal.
- [Plugins and middleware](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/plugin/): Official Casdoor plugins and middleware for Spring Boot, Quarkus, WordPress, Odoo, Django, Kibana, Chrome, and Terraform.
- [Sign users in to a Chrome extension](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/chrome-extension/): Add Casdoor sign-in to a Chrome extension with the Chrome identity API and the OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow.
- [Sign users in to a Next.js application](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/nextjs/): Add Casdoor sign-in to a Next.js application with casdoor-js-sdk, and protect routes with Next.js middleware.
- [Sign users in to a Nuxt application](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/nuxt/): Add Casdoor sign-in to a Nuxt application with casdoor-js-sdk, and protect routes with Nuxt middleware.
- [OAuth 2.0](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/oauth/): Reference for the OAuth 2.0 endpoints of Casdoor - every supported grant type, PKCE, resource indicators, DPoP, token introspection, and the UserInfo endpoint.
- [Sign users in as guests](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/guest-auth/): Create temporary users without a username or password, and turn them into regular users later.
- [Set up Kerberos sign-in](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/kerberos/): Configure Kerberos/SPNEGO (Integrated Windows Authentication), so that users on domain-joined machines sign in to Casdoor without entering credentials.
- [Connect a CAS client](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/cas/): Use Casdoor as a Central Authentication Service (CAS) server for CAS 1.0, 2.0, and 3.0 clients.
- [Use Casdoor as a SAML identity provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/saml/overview/): Connect a SAML 2.0 service provider to Casdoor - the metadata URL, the reply URL and entity ID, the response binding, SAML attributes, and assertion signatures.
- [Connect AWS Client VPN with SAML](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/saml/aws/): Use Casdoor as the SAML identity provider of AWS Client VPN, so that users sign in to the VPN with their Casdoor account.
- [Connect Keycloak with SAML](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/saml/keycloak/): Add Casdoor to Keycloak as a SAML 2.0 identity provider, so that users sign in to Keycloak with their Casdoor account.
- [Connect Google Workspace with SAML](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/saml/google-workspace/): Use Casdoor as the SAML identity provider of Google Workspace, so that users sign in to Google with their Casdoor account.
- [Connect Appgate SDP with SAML](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/saml/appgate/): Use Casdoor as the SAML identity provider of Appgate SDP, which receives the SAML response by POST.
- [Connect Tencent Cloud with SAML](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/saml/tencent-cloud/): Use Casdoor as the SAML identity provider of Tencent Cloud Access Management (CAM), so that users sign in to Tencent Cloud in a role.
- [MCP服务器概览](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/overview/): Casdoor exposes its management API as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at /api/mcp, and it can register, browse, and scan for external MCP servers.
- [MCP authentication](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/authentication/): How MCP clients discover the OAuth 2.0 requirements of the Casdoor MCP server, and the ways to authenticate a request.
- [MCP工具参考](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/tools/): The tools of the Casdoor MCP server for managing applications and users, how to list and call them, and the format of the results.
- [MCP授权和范围](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/authorization/): The OAuth 2.0 scopes that control which tools of the Casdoor MCP server a token can call, how to request them, and how to define scopes for your own MCP server.
- [Call the MCP server from Python](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/integration/): A Python example that gets an access token with scopes, initializes a session with the Casdoor MCP server, and calls tools.
- [MCP错误处理](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/error-handling/): The JSON-RPC error codes of the Casdoor MCP server, with example responses.
- [MCP 故障排除](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/troubleshooting/): Causes and fixes for common problems with the Casdoor MCP server and with MCP servers that use Casdoor as their OAuth 2.0 provider.
- [Connect Claude Desktop to the Casdoor MCP server](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/connect-claude-desktop/): Connect Claude Desktop to the Casdoor MCP server through mcp-remote and OAuth 2.0, so that Claude can manage applications and users in Casdoor.
- [Connect Cursor to the Casdoor MCP server](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/connect-cursor/): Connect the Cursor editor to the Casdoor MCP server with OAuth 2.0, so that the AI of Cursor can manage applications and users in Casdoor.
- [Connect ChatGPT to the Casdoor MCP server](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/connect-chatgpt/): Connect ChatGPT to the Casdoor MCP server with OAuth 2.0, so that ChatGPT can manage applications and users in Casdoor.
- [Set up Face ID sign-in](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/face-id/): Let users register their face in their Casdoor account and sign in by scanning it on the sign-in page.
- [Set up WebAuthn sign-in](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/webauthn/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with passkeys, fingerprint or face recognition, Windows Hello, or a security key through WebAuthn.

## 开发者指南

- [Frontend source code](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/developer-guide/frontend/): The layout of the Casdoor frontend source code in the web directory, and how to run and build it.
- [生成Swagger文件](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/developer-guide/swagger/): Regenerate the Swagger (OpenAPI) files of the Casdoor API with the modified bee tool after you add or change an API.

## 组织

- [Organizations](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/organization/overview/): An organization holds users and applications. This page describes the settings of an organization - password storage, avatars, usernames, soft deletion, and the navigation that members see.
- [Groups](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/organization/organization-tree/): Groups collect the users of an organization and form a tree. This page describes the properties of a group and where you manage groups.
- [Set password complexity rules](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/organization/passwordComplexity/): Require a minimum length, mixed character classes, special characters, or no repeated characters for the passwords of an organization.
- [Encrypt passwords in transit](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/organization/passwordObfuscator/): Make the Casdoor frontend encrypt passwords with AES or DES before it sends them to the sign-in and set-password APIs.
- [Customize the account page](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/organization/accountCustomization/): Choose which fields the account page of an organization shows, who can view and edit each field, and how the fields are grouped into tabs.
- [Customize the theme](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/organization/customize-theme/): Set the primary color and the border radius of the Casdoor pages for an organization or for a single application.
- [Require multi-factor authentication](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/organization/mfa-items/): Choose which multi-factor authentication methods an organization offers, and whether each one is optional, prompted, or required.

## 应用

- [Applications](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/overview/): An application represents one service that signs users in with Casdoor. This page explains what you configure on an application and how to update one through the API.
- [Application settings reference](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/terminology/): Reference for every field of the application edit page in the Casdoor admin console, organized by tab.
- [Create and configure an application](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/config/): Create an application in Casdoor, connect it to an organization, and set the redirect URL so that your service can sign users in.
- [Register clients dynamically](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/dynamic-client-registration/): Let software register itself as an OAuth 2.0 client of Casdoor with one HTTP request, as defined in RFC 7591, and control where this is allowed.
- [应用程序类别](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/categories/): The category of an application - Default for applications that users sign in to, Agent for machine clients - and the types that each category offers.
- [Define custom scopes](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/scopes/): Define your own OAuth 2.0 scopes on an Agent application, such as an MCP server, so that clients request only the permissions that they need.
- [Add providers to an application](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/providers/): Add identity, email, SMS, and other providers to an application, and choose for each one in which situations Casdoor uses it.
- [Choose the sign-in methods](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/signin-methods/): Choose which sign-in methods an application offers on its sign-in page, such as password, verification code, WebAuthn, and LDAP, and in which order.
- [Allow one session per user](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/exclusive-signin/): Limit each user to one active session per application, so that a new sign-in ends the sessions on other devices.
- [Customize the sign-up form](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/signup-items-table/): Choose which fields the sign-up page of an application shows, which are required, how they are validated, and how some of them behave.
- [Customize the sign-in page](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/signin-items-table/): Choose which elements the sign-in page of an application shows and how the forgot-password link, the language selector, and the captcha behave.
- [Customize the look of the sign-in page](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/ui-customization/): Change the background, the style, and the position of the sign-in form of an application, add a side panel, and move the design to another Casdoor instance.
- [Let users choose their organization at sign-in](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/specify-login-organization/): Show an organization picker or an organization field on the sign-in page, so that users of several organizations share one sign-in page.
- [Restrict sign-in by user tags](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/tags/): Allow only users with a matching tag to sign in to an application.
- [Require an invitation code at sign-up](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/invitation-code/): Allow only invited users to sign up to an application by requiring a valid invitation code on the sign-up page.
- [Share an application between organizations](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/shared-application/): Let the users of every organization sign in to one application, with a client ID per organization.

## MCP 授权

- [Use Casdoor as the authorization server of an MCP server](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/mcp-auth/overview/): Casdoor can be the OAuth 2.1 authorization server of your own MCP server, with dynamic client registration, PKCE, resource indicators, consent, and token validation through JWKS.
- [Set up Casdoor for your MCP server](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/mcp-auth/setup/): Configure an application, scopes, and dynamic client registration in Casdoor, and make your MCP server publish its metadata, challenge clients, and validate tokens.
- [Validate Casdoor tokens in your MCP server](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/mcp-auth/third-party-integration/): Complete MCP servers in Python, Node.js, and Go that publish Protected Resource Metadata, validate Casdoor tokens with JWKS, and enforce scopes.
- [Public MCP server registry](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/mcp-auth/mcp-registry/): The public MCP server registry at mcp.casdoor.org lists MCP servers with a web interface and a JSON API. This page explains how to use it and how to add a server.

## 权限

- [Permissions](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/permission/overview/): Casdoor permissions are built on Casbin. This page explains models, policies, and adapters, and how your application checks permissions through the Casdoor API.
- [Configure a permission](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/permission/permission-configuration/): Reference for the fields of the permission edit page - the model, the adapter, the subjects, the resources and actions, and the effect.
- [Casbin APIs](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/permission/exposed-casbin-apis/): Reference for the Casbin APIs of Casdoor - enforce, batch enforce, and the lists of objects, actions, and roles of a user - which your backend calls to check permissions.
- [Adapters](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/permission/adapter/): Connect Casdoor to a database table that holds Casbin policies, and view and edit the policies in the admin console.

## 提供商

- [Providers](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/overview/): Providers connect Casdoor to external services for sign-in, email, SMS, storage, payment, captcha, and more. This page lists the categories and explains who can use a provider.
- [OAuth providers](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/overview/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with an account at an external identity provider, such as Google or GitHub, and learn how Casdoor links and maps these accounts.
- [Map OAuth claims to user fields](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/user-mapping/): Fill in Casdoor user fields, such as the phone number or the job title, from the claims that an OAuth provider returns.
- [Add Google as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/google/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Google account.
- [Turn on Google One Tap](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/googleonetap/): Let users sign in on the Casdoor sign-in page with Google One Tap by setting the rule of the Google provider to One Tap.
- [Add GitHub as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/github/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their GitHub account, through the web flow or the device flow.
- [Add LinkedIn as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/linkedin/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their LinkedIn account.
- [Add Facebook as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/facebook/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Facebook account.
- [Add Sign in with Apple](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/apple/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Apple ID through Sign in with Apple.
- [Add Alipay as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/Alipay/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Alipay account, with certificate-based signing.
- [Add AD FS as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/adfs/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their account in Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS).
- [Add Azure AD as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/azureAD/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Microsoft account in Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID).
- [Add Azure AD B2C as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/azureADb2c/): Let customers sign in to Casdoor with their account in Azure AD B2C.
- [Add a custom OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/CustomProvider/): Connect Casdoor to any OAuth 2.0 identity provider that has no built-in type, and the requests and responses that the provider must support.
- [Add Okta as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/okta/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Okta account through OpenID Connect.
- [Add Twitter as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/Twitter/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Twitter (X) account.
- [Add Weibo as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/Weibo/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Weibo account.
- [Add WeChat as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/Wechat/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with WeChat, by scanning a QR code on a PC or inside the WeChat browser on a phone.
- [Add WeCom as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/weCom/): Let users sign in to Casdoor from the WeCom client, with an internal or a third-party WeCom application.
- [Add Tencent QQ as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/Tencent/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their QQ account through QQ Connect.
- [Add Telegram as a sign-in provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/telegram/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Telegram account through the Telegram Login Widget.
- [Add DingTalk as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/DingTalk/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their DingTalk account.
- [Add Steam as a sign-in provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/Steam/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Steam account, with a Steam Web API key.
- [Add Gitee as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/gitee/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Gitee account.
- [Add GitLab as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/gitlab/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their account on GitLab.com or on a self-hosted GitLab.
- [Add Baidu as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/baidu/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Baidu account.
- [Add Infoflow as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/infoflow/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their account in Baidu Infoflow.
- [Add Lark as an OAuth provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/oauth/lark/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Lark (Feishu) account.
- [Email providers](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/email/overview/): Configure an email provider that sends verification codes, password reset links, and notifications, and write the email templates.
- [Send email with SendGrid](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/email/sendgrid/): Use the SendGrid API as the email provider of Casdoor.
- [Send email with Resend](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/email/resend/): Use the Resend API as the email provider of Casdoor.
- [Send email with Azure Communication Services](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/email/azureACS/): Use Azure Communication Services (ACS) as the email provider of Casdoor.
- [Send email with Brevo](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/email/brevo/): Use the SMTP relay of Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) as the email provider of Casdoor.
- [Test email with MailHog](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/email/mailhog/): Catch the emails of Casdoor in MailHog, a local SMTP server for testing.
- [Test email with Mailpit](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/email/mailpit/): Catch the emails of Casdoor in Mailpit, a local SMTP server for testing.
- [SMS providers](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/sms/overview/): Configure an SMS provider that sends verification codes to phone numbers, and the SMS services that Casdoor supports.
- [Send SMS with Twilio](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/sms/twilio/): Use Twilio as the SMS provider of Casdoor.
- [Send SMS with Amazon SNS](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/sms/amazonSns/): Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) as the SMS provider of Casdoor.
- [Send SMS with Azure Communication Services](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/sms/acs/): Use Azure Communication Services (ACS) as the SMS provider of Casdoor.
- [Send SMS with Alibaba Cloud](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/sms/alibabaCloud/): Use the SMS service of Alibaba Cloud as the SMS provider of Casdoor.
- [Send SMS with Alibaba Cloud PNVS](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/sms/pnvs/): Use the Phone Number Verification Service (PNVS) of Alibaba Cloud as the SMS provider of Casdoor.
- [Send SMS through your own HTTP API](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/sms/customHttp/): Connect Casdoor to any SMS gateway that accepts an HTTP request, by describing the request in a Custom HTTP SMS provider.
- [Notification providers](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/notification/overview/): Send messages from Casdoor to chat services and HTTP endpoints, such as Slack, Telegram, and your own webhook.
- [Send notifications to Telegram](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/notification/telegram/): Send the notifications of Casdoor to a Telegram chat through a bot.
- [Send notifications to an HTTP endpoint](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/notification/customHttp/): Send the notifications of Casdoor to an HTTP endpoint of your own with a GET or POST request.
- [Send notifications to Slack](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/notification/slack/): Send the notifications of Casdoor to a Slack channel through a Slack app.
- [Send notifications to Google Chat](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/notification/googleChat/): Send the notifications of Casdoor to Google Chat with the credentials of a service account.
- [Send notifications to Twitter](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/notification/twitter/): Send the notifications of Casdoor to a Twitter (X) user.
- [Send notifications to Discord](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/notification/discord/): Send the notifications of Casdoor to a Discord channel through a bot.
- [Send notifications to WeCom](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/notification/wecom/): Send the notifications of Casdoor to a WeCom (WeChat Work) group through a group bot.
- [Storage providers](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/storage/overview/): Configure where Casdoor stores uploaded files, such as avatars, on the local file system or in cloud object storage.
- [Store files on the local file system](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/storage/localFileSystem/): Store uploaded files in the files directory of the Casdoor server.
- [Store files in Amazon S3](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/storage/amazon-s3/): Store uploaded files, such as avatars, in an Amazon S3 bucket.
- [Store files in Azure Blob Storage](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/storage/azure/): Store uploaded files, such as avatars, in a container of Azure Blob Storage.
- [Store files in Google Cloud Storage](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/storage/google-cloudstorage/): Store uploaded files, such as avatars, in a Google Cloud Storage bucket with a service account.
- [Store files in MinIO](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/storage/minio/): Store uploaded files, such as avatars, in MinIO or another S3-compatible object store.
- [Store files in Alibaba Cloud OSS](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/storage/aliyun-oss/): Store uploaded files in Alibaba Cloud OSS with an AccessKey or with RAM Roles for Service Accounts (RRSA).
- [Store files in Tencent Cloud COS](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/storage/tencentCloudCOS/): Store uploaded files, such as avatars, in a Tencent Cloud COS bucket.
- [Store files on a Synology NAS](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/storage/synology-nas/): Store uploaded files on a Synology NAS through its S3-compatible API.
- [SAML providers](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/saml/overview/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with an external SAML 2.0 identity provider, with Casdoor as the service provider.
- [Add a SAML identity provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/saml/custom/): Connect any SAML 2.0 identity provider to Casdoor with a Custom SAML provider, by registering Casdoor at the IdP and importing the metadata of the IdP.
- [Add Google Workspace as a SAML provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/saml/google-workspace/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Google Workspace account through SAML.
- [Add Azure AD as a SAML provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/saml/azure-ad/): Let users sign in to Casdoor with their Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID) account through SAML.
- [Add Keycloak as a SAML provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/saml/keycloak/): Let users of a Keycloak realm sign in to Casdoor through SAML.
- [Add Alibaba Cloud IDaaS as a SAML provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/saml/aliyun/): Let users of Alibaba Cloud IDaaS (EIAM) sign in to Casdoor through SAML.
- [Payment providers](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/overview/): Add payment providers to products, so that users can pay for them with a payment service or with their account balance.
- [Test purchases with the Dummy provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/dummy/): Simulate payments to test the purchase flow of Casdoor products without a payment service.
- [Let users pay from their balance](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/Balance/): Let users pay for products from their account balance in Casdoor, and top up the balance with a recharge product.
- [Take payments with PayPal](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/paypal/): Use PayPal as the payment provider of your Casdoor products.
- [Take payments with Stripe](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/stripe/): Use Stripe as the payment provider of your Casdoor products.
- [Take payments with Polar](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/Polar/): Use Polar as the payment provider of your Casdoor products.
- [Take payments with Paddle](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/Paddle/): Use Paddle as the payment provider of your Casdoor products.
- [Take payments with FastSpring](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/FastSpring/): Use FastSpring as the payment provider of your Casdoor products.
- [Take payments with Lemon Squeezy](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/LemonSqueezy/): Use Lemon Squeezy as the payment provider of your Casdoor products.
- [Take payments with Adyen](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/Adyen/): Use Adyen as the payment provider of your Casdoor products.
- [Take payments with Alipay](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/Alipay/): Use Alipay as the payment provider of your Casdoor products, with certificate-based signing.
- [Take payments with WeChat Pay](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/WeChatPay/): Use WeChat Pay as the payment provider of your Casdoor products, with Native payment and JSAPI payment inside WeChat.
- [Take payments with AirWallex](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/AirWallex/): Use AirWallex as the payment provider of your Casdoor products.
- [Captcha providers](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/captcha/overview/): Require a captcha at sign-in, at sign-up, and before Casdoor sends verification codes, and choose when the captcha appears.
- [Use the default captcha](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/captcha/default/): Use the built-in image captcha of Casdoor, which needs no external service.
- [Use Cloudflare Turnstile](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/captcha/cloudflareTurnstile/): Protect sign-in and sign-up with Cloudflare Turnstile, a captcha alternative that respects privacy.
- [Use Google reCAPTCHA](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/captcha/recaptcha/): Protect sign-in and sign-up with Google reCAPTCHA.
- [Use hCaptcha](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/captcha/hcaptcha/): Protect sign-in and sign-up with hCaptcha.
- [Use Alibaba Cloud Captcha](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/captcha/aliyunCaptcha/): Protect sign-in and sign-up with Alibaba Cloud Captcha, with sliding or intelligent validation.
- [Use Geetest](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/captcha/geetest/): Protect sign-in and sign-up with Geetest CAPTCHA V4.
- [MetaMask Web3](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/web3/metamask/): 将MetaMask用作Web3登录提供商。
- [Web3-Onboard](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/web3/web3onboard/): 用 Web3-Onboard 支持多种钱包进行 Web3 登录。
- [人脸识别概览](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/faceid/overview/): 把人脸识别用作登录方式。
- [Alibaba Cloud FaceBody](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/faceid/alibaba_cloud_facebody/): 使用阿里云人体识别（FaceBody）做人脸验证。
- [身份核验提供商概览](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/idv/overview/): 通过第三方身份核验（KYC）提供商核验用户身份。
- [Jumio 身份核验](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/idv/jumio/): 在 Casdoor 中把 Jumio 用作身份核验（KYC）提供商。
- [阿里云](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/idv/alibaba-cloud/): 把阿里云身份核验用作 Casdoor 的身份核验提供商，将用户的居民身份证与政府记录比对。
- [日志提供商](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/log/overview/): 把操作系统日志、SELinux 审计事件、OpenTelemetry 数据和权限审计事件收集到 Casdoor 的 Entry 记录中。
- [扫描提供商概览](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/scan/overview/): 扫描网络和网页目标，发现服务器或安全问题，例如 MCP 发现或漏洞扫描。
- [MCP Scan](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/scan/mcp/): 扫描内网地址段，发现 MCP 服务器。
- [安全扫描](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/scan/security/): 识别网页目标的指纹，报告匹配的已知漏洞（CVE）。

- [概述](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/resources/overview/): 用存储提供商把文件和图片作为资源上传和管理。

## SaaS 管理

- [概述](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/pricing/overview/): 把 Casdoor 用于订阅和定价：计划、支付和订阅。
- [产品](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/products/product/): 定义要出售的商品（或服务），并关联支付提供商。
- [商品商店](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/products/product-store/): 把商品发布到商店，用户可以浏览和购买
- [购物车](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/products/cart/): Casdoor 购物车可以收集多件商品，让用户在一个订单中一次付款全部买下。
- [支付](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/products/payment/): 查看支付记录、状态，并开具发票。
- [排序](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/products/order/): Casdoor 订单记录每一次商品购买，并跟踪其生命周期，与为它付款的支付记录分开。
- [计划](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/pricing/plan/): 定义计划的功能和价格；计划与角色和商品关联。
- [定价](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/pricing/): 把一个或多个计划组合在一起，用户注册时可以选择不同的价位。
- [订阅](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/pricing/subscription/): 管理用户选择的计划和应用访问权限。
- [交易](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/pricing/transaction/): 跟踪用户和组织的付款与余额变动。
- [优惠券](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/pricing/coupon/): 创建折扣优惠券，在结账时用于订单。

## 多因素认证

- [MFA / 2FA](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/user/multi-factor-authentication/): 使用MFA / 2FA保护您的账户
- [Use the Casdoor Authenticator app](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/totp-authenticator-app/): Install Casdoor Authenticator, an open-source TOTP app for Android and iOS, connect it to Casdoor, and import accounts from other authenticator apps.
- [推送通知](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/mfa/push/): 使用 Casdoor 通知提供商，通过 Duo、Pushover 等推送服务发送 MFA 验证码。
- [RADIUS MFA](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/mfa/radius/): 把外部 RADIUS 服务器用作 MFA 提供商。

## 用户

- [概述](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/user/overview/): Casdoor中的用户模型、属性、角色、权限及批量导入。
- [用户冒充](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/user/impersonation/): 以其他用户身份登录，以便在无需知晓其密码的情况下进行支持和测试。
- [用户角色](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/user/roles/): 为用户分配和管理角色；将角色与权限策略结合使用。
- [用户权限](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/user/permissions/): 为用户和角色分配权限；使用权限API。
- [表格](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/user/forms/): 自定义核心实体的列表页面列和布局。

## 邀请码

- [概述](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/invitation/overview/): 只允许持有有效邀请码的用户注册。

## IP 白名单

- [IP 白名单](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/ip-whitelist/): 按客户端 IP 限制对登录、注册和忘记密码页面的访问。

## 站点

- [站点](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/site/overview/): 配置带有SSL、健康检查和流量规则的反向代理站点。
- [Add login to an app without OIDC](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/site/protect-app/): Put Casdoor in front of an app that has no login or no OIDC support, and pass the signed-in user to it.

## 规则

- [规则](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/rule/overview/): 为站点定义流量控制规则（IP、User-Agent、速率限制、WAF）。

## 同步器

- [概述](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/overview/): 将外部系统（数据库、Azure AD、Keycloak 等）中的用户同步到 Casdoor。
- [数据库同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/Database/): 从外部数据库同步用户数据到Casdoor。
- [Azure AD 同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/AzureAD/): <b通过Microsoft Graph将用户从Azure Active Directory（Microsoft Entra ID）同步到Casdoor。
- [Active Directory 同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/ActiveDirectory/): 通过LDAP/LDAPS将用户从Microsoft Active Directory同步到Casdoor。
- [Google Workspace 同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/GoogleWorkspace/): 通过Admin SDK目录API，将Google Workspace中的用户同步到Casdoor。
- [Keycloak同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/Keycloak/): 将用户从 Keycloak 同步到 Casdoor，并自动映射模式。
- [Okta同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/Okta/): 通过Okta用户API将用户从Okta同步到Casdoor。
- [SCIM 2.0同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/SCIM/): 从任何符合SCIM 2.0标准的身份提供商中将用户拉入Casdoor。
- [AWS IAM同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/AWSIAM/): 将 AWS IAM 中的用户和组同步到 Casdoor。
- [WeCom 同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/WeCom/): 通过WeCom API将用户从企业微信同步到Casdoor。
- [DingTalk同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/DingTalk/): 通过钉钉API将用户从钉钉同步到Casdoor。
- [Lark同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/Lark/): 通过Lark开放平台API，将用户从Lark（飞书）同步到Casdoor。

## 集成

- [Nginx](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/C++/Nginx/): 以 Casdoor 作为身份提供商，为 NGINX Plus 代理的应用启用 OpenID Connect 单点登录。
- [Nginx 社区版](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/C++/NginxCommunityVersion/): 用 OAuth2 Proxy 和 auth_request，为开源版 Nginx（不是 NGINX Plus）后面的应用加上 Casdoor 单点登录。
- [Envoy](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/C++/Envoy/): 使用 Envoy 的 OAuth2 过滤器和一个 Casdoor 应用，为 Envoy 代理后面的服务加上 Casdoor 单点登录保护。
- [Unity](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/CSharp/Unity/): 使用Casdoor-dotnet-sdk进行Unity开发。
- [Kubernetes](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/go/kubernetes/): 以 Casdoor 作为 OIDC 身份提供商，用 OpenID Connect 为 kubectl 访问 Kubernetes API server 的用户做认证。
- [OpenShift](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/go/openshift/): 把 Casdoor 配置为 OpenShift 的 OpenID Connect 身份提供商，用户就能用 Casdoor 账号登录控制台和 CLI。
- [BookStack](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/go/bookstack/): 把 Casdoor 设置为开源 wiki 和文档平台 BookStack 的 OAuth 登录提供商。
- [Bytebase](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/go/Bytebase/): 把 Casdoor 用作 Bytebase SSO 的 OAuth2/OIDC 提供商。
- [ELK](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/go/elk/): 用 elk-auth-casdoor 或 casdoor-forward-auth 在 Kibana 前加上 Casdoor 单点登录，无需 X-Pack 的付费 SSO 功能。
- [Gitea](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/go/gitea/): 把 Casdoor 用作 Gitea 登录的 OAuth/OIDC 提供商。
- [Grafana](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/go/grafana/): 把 Casdoor 用作 Grafana 登录的 OAuth 提供商。
- [MinIO](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/go/minio/): 将Casdoor配置为身份提供商以支持MinIO
- [Traefik](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/go/traefik/): 用 casdoor-forward-auth 和 Traefik 的 forwardAuth 中间件，以 Casdoor SSO 保护 Traefik 后面的服务。
- [Caddy](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/go/caddy/): Protect services behind Caddy with Casdoor SSO using casdoor-forward-auth and Caddy's forward_auth directive.
- [OAuth2 Proxy](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/go/oauth2-proxy/): Put OAuth2 Proxy in front of any web application with Casdoor as the OIDC provider, and let in only members of a Casdoor group or holders of a Casdoor role.
- [Portainer](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/go/portainer/): 以 Casdoor 作为身份提供商配置 Portainer 的 OAuth 登录，用户就能用 Casdoor 账号登录 Portainer。
- [Argo CD](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/go/argocd/): Sign in to the Argo CD UI and CLI with Casdoor over OpenID Connect, and grant Argo CD roles to Casdoor groups.
- [Spring Boot](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/spring-boot/): 用 casdoor-spring-boot-starter 为 Spring Boot 应用加上 Casdoor 登录：配置、登录跳转、回调和用户信息。
- [Spring Cloud](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/spring-cloud/): 在网关处或在各个服务中用 casdoor-spring-boot-starter，为 Spring Cloud 微服务加上 Casdoor 认证。
- [Spring Cloud Gateway](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/spring-cloud-gateway/): 在 Spring Cloud Gateway 中使用 casdoor-spring-boot-starter，用 Casdoor 认证请求。
- [Quarkus](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/quarkus/): Sign in to Quarkus applications with Casdoor and authorize requests with Casdoor roles and permissions using the Quarkus Casdoor Auth extension.
- [Spring Security OAuth](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/spring-security/spring-security-oauth/): 用 spring-boot-starter-oauth2-client 把 Casdoor 作为 Spring Security 应用的 OpenID Connect 提供商。
- [Spring Security 过滤器（OIDC）](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/spring-security/spring-security-filter/): 用 OIDC 把 Casdoor 集成到 Spring Security。
- [Jenkins 插件](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/jenkins-plugin/): 安装并配置 Jenkins 的 Casdoor 插件，用户就能通过 Casdoor 单点登录进入 Jenkins。
- [Jenkins（OIDC）](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/jenkins-oidc/): 把 Casdoor 用作 Jenkins 登录的 OIDC IdP。
- [使用内置 SSO](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/jira2/): 用 Jira 内置的 SSO 通过 OpenID Connect 接入 Casdoor，这种方式免费，但需要 HTTPS。
- [使用 miniOrange 插件](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/jira/): 用 miniOrange OAuth / OIDC SSO 插件，通过 OpenID Connect 把 Jira 接入 Casdoor。
- [用 OIDC 协议连接应用：Confluence](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/Confluence/): 用 OpenID Connect 把 Atlassian Confluence 接入 Casdoor，用户通过 Casdoor 单点登录进入 Confluence。
- [RuoYi](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/RuoYi/): 使用 Casdoor Java SDK，把 Casdoor 单点登录集成到 Spring Cloud 后台框架 RuoYi-Cloud。
- [Pulsar manager](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/Pulsar-manager/): 为 Apache Pulsar Manager 启用 Casdoor 登录：在后端配置 application.yml，并在前端打开 Casdoor 开关。
- [在 ShenYu 中使用Cassoor](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/shenyu/): 用 ShenYu 的 Casdoor 插件，以 Casdoor 保护 Apache ShenYu 网关后面的 API。
- [ShardingSphere](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/ShardingSphere/): 为已内置 Casdoor 支持的 Apache ShardingSphere ElasticJob UI 启用 Casdoor 登录。
- [Apache IoTDB](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/iotdb/): 为已内置 Casdoor 支持的 Apache IoTDB Web Workbench 启用 Casdoor 登录。
- [Apache DolphinScheduler](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/dolphinscheduler/): 为 Apache DolphinScheduler 启用 Casdoor 单点登录，它已把 Casdoor 作为内置登录方式。
- [FireZone](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/firezone/): 把 Firezone 配置为以 Casdoor 作为 OpenID Connect 身份提供商登录。
- [Cloud Foundry](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/CloudFoundry/): 把 Casdoor 用作 Cloud Foundry 上应用的 OIDC 身份提供商，附 Casdoor 和 Cloud Foundry 的分步配置。
- [Thingsboard](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/java/Thingsboard/): 把 Casdoor 用作物联网平台 ThingsBoard 的 OAuth 2.0 / OIDC 身份提供商，附 Casdoor 和 ThingsBoard 的设置。
- [Firebase](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/javascript/firebase/): 在 Firebase Authentication 中把 Casdoor 用作 OpenID Connect 提供商，Firebase 网页应用的用户就能用 Casdoor 登录。
- [微信小程序](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/javascript/wechat_miniprogram/): 在微信小程序中集成 Casdoor 登录（不走 OAuth 跳转）。
- [Immich](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/javascript/immich/): Sign in to Immich, in the browser and in the mobile apps, with Casdoor over OAuth and OpenID Connect.
- [APISIX](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/lua/apisix/): 用 authz-casdoor 插件或 openid-connect 插件，以 Casdoor 保护 Apache APISIX 后面的 API。
- [Zabbix](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/php/Zabbix/): 把 Casdoor 用作 Zabbix SSO 的 SAML IdP。
- [WordPress（CAS SSO）](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/php/WordPress/): 通过 wp-cassify 插件，把 Casdoor 用作 WordPress 的 CAS IdP。
- [禅道](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/php/zentao/): 用 zentao-oidc 模块为禅道项目管理工具加上 Casdoor 单点登录。
- [在ShowDoc中使用Casdoor作为OAuth2服务器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/php/showdoc/): 把 Casdoor 用作 API 和技术文档平台 ShowDoc 登录的 OAuth 2.0 服务器。
- [Flarum](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/php/Flarum/): 用 FoF Passport 扩展为 Flarum 论坛加上 Casdoor OAuth 2.0 登录。
- [Moodle](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/php/Moodle/): 把 Moodle 配置为以 Casdoor 作为 OAuth 身份提供商，实现单点登录。
- [Nextcloud](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/php/nextcloud/): Sign in to Nextcloud with Casdoor through the OpenID Connect user backend app, with Casdoor usernames as Nextcloud user IDs and Casdoor groups as Nextcloud groups.
- [Proxmox VE](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/perl/proxmox/): Add Casdoor to Proxmox VE as an OpenID Connect realm, so administrators sign in to the web interface with their Casdoor account and get permissions from Casdoor groups.
- [GitLab](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/ruby/gitlab/): 把自托管的 GitLab 配置为以 Casdoor 作为 OpenID Connect 提供商，实现单点登录。
- [Vaultwarden](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/rust/vaultwarden/): Sign in to Vaultwarden with Casdoor over OpenID Connect, using the SSO support built into Vaultwarden 1.35.0 and later.
- [Hasura](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/Haskell/Hasura/): 用 Casdoor 签发的 JWT 保护 Hasura GraphQL Engine：配置 Casdoor 应用、Hasura 的 JWT 密钥和声明映射。
- [FastAPI](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/python/FastAPI/): 用社区库 casbin-fastapi-decorator 为 FastAPI 应用加上 Casdoor 登录和 Casdoor 权限检查。
- [JumpServer](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/python/JumpServer/): 通过 CAS 把 JumpServer 堡垒机接入 Casdoor，用户就能用 Casdoor 单点登录。
- [Open WebUI](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/integration/python/open-webui/): Sign in to Open WebUI with Casdoor over OpenID Connect, and sync Open WebUI groups from Casdoor groups.

## Agents

- [Agents](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/agent/overview/): 在 Casdoor 注册和管理 Agents。

- [Prometheus](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/monitoring/Prometheus/): 用 Prometheus 抓取 Casdoor 指标。
